main_idea: GRPO raises Qwen3.8-27B DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO improves DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points.
Training used 500 tasks from a larger dataset.
Each task had eight attempts ranked against each other.
Mean training reward rose over 15 updates.
The training set was mostly feature requests.
summary: The lower dataset and training diagnostics, plus repeated result callouts, distract from a complete DeepSWE pass-rate comparison.
